summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of How-to-Make-Cheese-on-Toast SPA on mobile viewport 414x896. Tested home page, navigation, all 5 recipe detail pages, ingredient toggle, full simulator state machine (stages 0->5->6), timer countup, perfect outcome, fire/nuclear outcome with flame DOM, reset, and SEO (titles + JSON-LD). 14/14 critical assertions pass. One pre-existing UX issue: 'Made with Emergent' overlay visually overlaps bottom-nav 'Sandbox' tap area on mobile (overlay bbox x=220-398, y=840-880 vs nav-sim bbox x=276-414, y=839-896). The header SANDBOX link works fine as a workaround.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Made with Emergent' floating overlay overlaps the bottom-nav 'Sandbox' tab on mobile viewport (414x896). The button is functionally reachable but visually obscured and may be hard to tap for end users. The 'SANDBOX' button in the top header (data-testid=header-sim-link) is unobstructed and works as a clean workaround.

action_items: Optional: increase bottom-nav padding-bottom or shift nav-sim left to avoid the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlap at the bottom-right on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Simulator.jsx: useEffect for grill timer has eslint-disable comment for exhaustive-deps; finish() is referenced but not in deps. This is intentional (avoids re-creating interval on every render) but consider useCallback + ref pattern for clarity.
Home.jsx '*' route falls back to <Home /> but does not redirect URL; bookmarks to invalid paths will display home content under a wrong URL (minor SEO concern). Consider <Navigate to="/" replace />.
RecipeDetail.jsx: ingredient checklist state is per-mount and not persisted (acceptable for an SPA recipe view).
SeoHead.jsx: canonical link uses canonicalPath as-is (relative path) rather than absolute URL. Some SEO tools prefer absolute URL with origin prefix. Consider window.location.origin + canonicalPath.
seed_data_creation: None — pure frontend SPA, recipes defined statically in /app/frontend/src/data/recipes.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flagship simulator flows verified: 5 stages, auto-progress from stage 2 to 3 in ~4s, timer accel (24 simSec/realSec confirmed: 4:24 reached after 11 real seconds), flame DOM appears when simSec>240, fire/nuclear outcome image renders. All 5 recipe pages render with steps. Mobile tap targets (CTA height 48px+) and zero horizontal overflow on 414x896. SEO JSON-LD Recipe schema present and parseable on home and recipe-detail pages with @type=Recipe and recipeIngredient/recipeInstructions arrays.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found. Minor cosmetic overlap of Emergent badge with bottom-nav-sim is environment-level overlay, not an app bug.
